text:
customer-jd: Hi — customer reports GitHub SSO failing on our app. They get redirected back to /auth/callback but we return 400 PKCE verification failed. They pasted the full returned URL: https://app.redwood.ai/auth/callback?code=GH-xyz&state=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9+abcd==
jenna (Support): ack — can you grab the raw URL they see (copy from address bar) and a HAR if possible? the "+" in the state looks suspicious (should be url-safe base64).
customer-jd: pasted raw from user — they say their corp proxy is F5. They tried in incognito and it works, so looks like network rewrite. HAR incoming.
sarah (Support Engineer): quick check — our auth logs show: 
```
auth:oauth: verifier mismatch for session 0x7f3e - expected: tF3-... - got: tF3 ... (spaces)
```
looks like the state lost a "+" -> " " conversion.
mike (SRE): F5/legacy proxies often convert + to space if querystring isn't encoded or if Content-Type handling is wrong. Also some middleboxes try to normalize percent-encoding.
jenna (Support): customer: can you ask the proxy admin to verify their URL normalization settings? specifically ensure query strings are not decoded/re-encoded. If they can't, ask them to use URL-safe base64 (base64url) for the state so + and / are replaced.
customer-jd: they replied — proxy team says "we strip plus signs for compatibility" and can't change for legacy apps. They asked if we have a workaround on our side.
sarah (Support Engineer): two options: 1) accept some alternate state encodings server-side by normalizing spaces -> + before PKCE check (risky), 2) canonicalize by expecting base64url (recommended). We can support fallback decode for this customer only.
mike (SRE): if we implement fallback, do it as an opt-in tenant-level toggle (safer). Implementation: when PKCE verification fails, try replacing ' ' with '+' in state and re-run verify; log fallback usage and alert if used often.
jenna (Support): can we reproduce? sarah, can you paste a minimal curl reproducer for SRE to test?
sarah (Support Engineer): sure — reproducer: 
```
# simulating a proxy that replaces + with space
curl -i "https://app.redwood.ai/auth/callback?code=GH-abc&state=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9 abcd==" \
  -H "Host: app.redwood.ai"
```
(note the space where + should be)
mike (SRE): got it. Reproduced locally by sending space in place of +, server returns 400. Adding quick patch to try space->+ fallback in auth middleware for a tenant opt-in.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: branch fix/oauth-space-fallback -> staging (build 9203).
jenna (Support): great. customer-jd, please tell customer we'll enable a tenant fallback for their org and roll to staging for testing. we'll monitor for false positives. Ticket: SUP-21-487.
customer-jd: thanks — they asked if we can also add a guidance note to doc about using base64url for PKCE state.
sarah (Support Engineer): will add doc blurb in oauth.md: recommend base64url (RFC4648 §5), example: replace '+' with '-' and '/' with '_' and drop padding.
mike (SRE): quick checklist for rollout: 1) enable tenant opt-in flag, 2) server fallback: replace ' ' -> '+' then verify PKCE, 3) audit log entry when fallback used, 4) run canary on staging, 5) notify security for small risk review.
jenna (Support): closing loop: I'll update customer when staging patch is live and request they re-test from behind their proxy. :thumbsup:
customer-jd: will update once they confirm. thanks everyone!
